evaluations.claim: The SimSMoE model stabilizes at approximately 1.15 BPC by 50,000 steps, slightly above the black line.
evaluations.reality: The SimSMoE model stabilizes at approximately 1.1 BPC by 50,000 steps, slightly below the black line.

evaluations.claim: The SimSMoE model consistently outperforms the SMoE model across all training steps, as evidenced by its lower BPC values throughout the plot.
